text:
katy: Hey @people-ops — quick Q. My flight to Tokyo was cancelled by the airline yesterday and I had to rebook on a later flight. My original hotel was nonrefundable; I changed dates and paid a $120 change fee, paid $45 for early check-in at the new hotel, and used hotel laundry for $32. Also effectively lost one night of the original booking (nonrefundable). Can the change fee, early check-in, and laundry be reimbursed? Do I need any retro pre-approval? receipts attached.

people-ops: Sorry about the mess, katy — Ugh. Short answer: we generally reimburse unavoidable, reasonable costs caused by carrier/itinerary disruptions (change fees, incidental services like laundry, early check-in) when you provide receipts and proof of the disruption. Nonrefundable lost nights are handled case-by-case. Please do the following so we can process quickly:
1) Submit an expense in Ramp under category "Travel - Change/Cancellation" (or your expense tool) and attach:
   - airline cancellation/notification or screenshot of the cancelled flight
   - original hotel booking and new hotel invoice showing the change fee/early check-in/laundry line items
   - credit card or folio charge showing amounts
2) In the expense description add the flight PNR, timeline, and short rationale (e.g., "flight cancelled by airline, rebooked + change fee charged").
3) Select "travel-exception" tag and request your manager approval in the expense flow. We'll fast-track approvals for airline-caused disruptions.

mike-travel: one more thing — if the airline issued any partial refund/credit for the cancelled flight or unused night, include evidence. If you can get a refund for the unused night later, we may claw back the reimbursement.

sophie: FWIW I had a similar case last quarter — they approved the $100 change fee + early check-in and my laundry ($28), but denied the nonrefundable lost night because there was no airline proof. receipts and the airline email made the difference. :thumbsup:

people-ops: A few policy notes: per diem does NOT cover laundry; laundry is reimbursable as an incidental when it's a direct result of an enforced itinerary change. Personal upgrades, minibar, or leisure cancellations are not reimbursable. Timeline: once you submit with docs and manager approval we generally resolve within 2 business days. If you need an advance/temporary card charge covered, ping travel@redwood.com and cc your manager.

katy: Thanks — filing now and will attach airline cancellation email. cc @anna (my manager)

anna: Approved pending receipts — thanks for filing, katy. :white_check_mark:
